full_judgment: 36. In the case of Mallin Lal Vs. Joytun which arose. out of a proceeding under section 96 .of the East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Act and was decided by Asir J, sitting singly, the learned Judge appears to have preferred the view of the Madras High Court and held that the trial Court can exercise the power under Order 9 rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure for setting aside an exparte order even after the appeal which was preferred against the said order has been disposed of. It may be noted that the applicant in the proceeding under Order 9 rule 13 C.P.C. and the appellant against the exparte order was the same person.
